capabilities: Create and navigate monthly worklog workbenches by year and month
Log, edit, and delete daily work-hour entries with same-day duplicate prevention
View yearly dashboards with totals, monthly trends, task-type shares, and project statistics
Auto-generate monthly and year-end summary reports from previous data
Maintain task types, colors, and default task templates in settings
extras: The README is written in Chinese. Data is stored in local JSON files under year folders rather than in Markdown notes, and the report auto-creation feature generates templates and summaries on fixed dates (1st of each month, January 1st).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record daily work hours per task and aggregate them into monthly and yearly statistics.
summary: Local time-tracking plugin that manages monthly worklogs with tasks, daily work-hour entries, calendars, and yearly statistics dashboards.
